answer: Assembling that for 80 aliases means 80 times 4 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. Because each knoll escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the mirror ledger records every share and the mesa audit shows the split. A bond must be split across 4 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. That is 11 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
